frames.caption: 01 · SAMPLE — Is the comparison set honest?. Define seasons, object types, images, dates, sources, missing records, and selection criteria before describing a pattern. Do not cherry-pick only the most recognizable work.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping is the comparison set honest? within Seven Seasons of Signal.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · CODE — What exactly recurs?. Code silhouette, proportion, material, construction, color, gesture, image, language, casting, and refusal as separate observable fields. Keep description distinct from interpretation.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what exactly recurs? within Seven Seasons of Signal.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · EXCEPTION — What does change reveal?. Record deliberate departures, commercial compromises, collaborator interventions, technical limits, and failed experiments. Exceptions show whether the method governs more than a motif.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what does change reveal? within Seven Seasons of Signal.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CLAIM — What may be said or protected?. Separate cultural recognition, creator testimony, trademark evidence, product-design trade dress, copyrightable expression, design rights, and unresolved legal questions. Route protection claims to jurisdiction-specific counsel.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
